notes: Multimeter USB overhaul aligned with the proven pyusb reference (Lab1717/owon-hds-usb_streamer) after a tester showed a V11-firmware HDS242 answers raw USB fine while BoardScope could not connect: replaced the per-query read pairing with a persistent bulk-IN read loop feeding the same line parser the serial transport uses — stale and late replies are now handled instead of desyncing the connection; the connect handshake now starts with *IDN? (verified working by the tester) and gives the first query a 3000 ms window like the reference; and every connection step is now logged — launch BoardScope from a terminal to see [METER] lines live, or press the new LOG button in the meter window to copy the whole diagnostics trail for a bug report.
